# ADDRESS TABLE (generated by tools/audit-addr-table.js - do not edit by hand)

One row per analog address text of the drawings: which wire / symbol it was tied to, HOW, and how far it is. The simulator shows ONE live value beside each of these texts, read from the net in column "net". `AI ref` = the value of the AI block (the wire is flagged digital by the SIG.AB branch). Texts that could not be tied without guessing are NOT shown a value; they are in docs/ADDRESS-REVIEW.md.

Total: 1517 texts tied, 2 not tied.
